name: PacificWest Conference — $2,000 Glara Staging Realtor Giveaway
public_description:
Visit Glara Staging at PacificWest Conference and enter for your chance to win a $2,000 CAD Glara Staging Credit toward an eligible home staging project.

Whether you're preparing your next listing or planning ahead, we'd love to introduce you to Glara Staging and show you how professional staging can help transform a property for market.
eligibility_summary: Licensed Realtors in British Columbia. One eligible entry per Realtor. No purchase necessary. Identity, BC licence and eligibility verification, plus a correctly answered mathematical skill-testing question, are required before winner confirmation.
official_rules:
OFFICIAL GIVEAWAY RULES

PacificWest Conference — $2,000 Glara Staging Realtor Giveaway

NO PURCHASE NECESSARY.

These Official Rules govern the Glara Staging $2,000 Realtor Giveaway (the “Giveaway”).

By entering the Giveaway, an entrant agrees to be bound by these Official Rules.


1. Sponsor

The Giveaway is sponsored by:

Glara Import Ltd., operating as Glara Home / Glara Staging  
British Columbia, Canada

(the “Sponsor”).


2. Giveaway Period

The Giveaway begins:

September 28, 2026 at 8:00 AM Pacific Time

and closes:

September 29, 2026 at 5:00 PM Pacific Time

(the “Giveaway Period”).

Entries received outside the Giveaway Period will not be eligible.

The Sponsor’s system time will be the official timekeeping mechanism for online entries.


3. Eligibility

The Giveaway is open to eligible licensed real estate professionals who:

- are legally eligible to participate under these Official Rules;
- are located or conduct real estate business within British Columbia;
- complete the required Giveaway registration;
- provide accurate registration information;
- accept these Official Rules; and
- satisfy any other eligibility requirements disclosed in these Official Rules.

Employees, officers, directors and representatives of the Sponsor, and any other persons directly involved in administering the Giveaway, are not eligible to enter.

The Sponsor may require reasonable information to verify eligibility before confirming a winner.


4. How to Enter

During the Giveaway Period, visit https://glarahome.com/win and complete the required registration form.

The registration form may request:

- first and last name;
- brokerage;
- email address;
- mobile phone number;
- city or primary real estate market;
- confirmation of Realtor/licensing status; and
- approximate annual listing volume.

A purchase is not required to enter.


5. Entry Limit

Limit of one (1) eligible entry per Realtor during the Giveaway.

Submitting the registration form more than once does not provide additional chances to win.

Duplicate registrations may be consolidated or excluded from the draw pool as necessary to maintain one eligible entry per person.


6. Marketing Consent

Consent to receive marketing communications from Glara Staging is optional and is not required to enter or win the Giveaway.

Choosing or declining marketing communications does not increase or decrease an entrant’s chances of winning.


7. Prize

There is one (1) prize available.

The prize is:

One $2,000 CAD Glara Staging Credit

Approximate retail value:

CAD $2,000

The credit may be applied toward an eligible Glara Staging home staging service in accordance with the prize terms described below.

The prize is not cash.


8. Prize Terms

The $2,000 Glara Staging Credit:

- may be applied toward an eligible Glara Staging project, with any unused balance retained until expiry;
- has no cash redemption value;
- may not be exchanged for cash;
- is subject to Glara Staging service availability;
- must be used within six (6) calendar months after the winner is officially confirmed (America/Vancouver time);
- is non-transferable;
- may not be combined with any other promotion, coupon, discount, or promotional credit; and
- is subject to any additional reasonable service terms disclosed before the prize is accepted.

If the eligible staging service selected by the winner costs more than the available credit, the winner is responsible for the remaining amount.

If the eligible staging service costs less than the available credit:

Any unused portion of the $2,000 credit remains available to the confirmed winner until the six-month expiry date.

The prize may not be sold or converted to cash.


9. Odds of Winning

The odds of winning depend on the total number of eligible entries received during the Giveaway Period.

Each eligible entry included in the draw has an equal chance of selection.

Commercial value, brokerage, annual listing volume, marketing consent, previous relationship with Glara Staging, or internal lead-priority classification will not provide additional entries or improve an entrant’s odds of winning.


10. Random Draw

After the Giveaway closes, the Sponsor will conduct a random draw from all eligible entries.

The draw will use cryptographically secure random selection from the frozen eligible-entry pool in the Sponsor’s controlled electronic giveaway system.

The Sponsor will record the eligible draw pool and selection for administrative and audit purposes.

The person initially selected is a potential winner only and is not confirmed as the winner until all required verification steps have been successfully completed.


11. Winner Verification

Before being confirmed as the winner, the selected entrant must:

- satisfy all Giveaway eligibility requirements;
- provide reasonable confirmation of identity and professional eligibility if requested;
- comply with these Official Rules; and
- correctly answer, without assistance, a time-limited mathematical skill-testing question administered by the Sponsor.

The Sponsor may contact the selected entrant using the email address or telephone number provided with the entry.

The selected entrant has three (3) business days from Glara Staging’s first contact attempt to respond and complete the requested winner-verification process. If they do not respond within that period, they may be disqualified and an alternate entrant may be selected according to these Official Rules.


12. Disqualification and Alternate Selection

A selected entrant may be disqualified if the entrant:

- cannot be contacted within the required response period;
- fails to satisfy the eligibility requirements;
- provided materially false or incomplete entry information;
- fails to correctly answer the required skill-testing question;
- declines the prize; or
- otherwise fails to comply with these Official Rules.

If a selected entrant is disqualified, the Sponsor may conduct another random draw from the remaining eligible entries.

The original selection and any subsequent redraw may be retained in the Sponsor’s Giveaway administration records.


13. Award of Prize

The prize will be awarded only after the selected entrant has successfully completed the required verification.

The Sponsor will make reasonable efforts to award the prize without undue delay.

The confirmed winner will receive instructions regarding the use and expiry of the Glara Staging Credit.


14. Personal Information

Personal information submitted in connection with the Giveaway will be collected and used for purposes reasonably related to:

- administering the Giveaway;
- verifying eligibility;
- preventing duplicate or fraudulent entries;
- contacting the selected entrant;
- awarding and administering the prize; and
- maintaining appropriate Realtor relationship records.

If an entrant separately provides marketing consent, the Sponsor may also use the entrant’s contact information for the marketing purposes described at the time consent is obtained.

Marketing consent is not required to enter or win.

Personal information will be handled in accordance with applicable privacy requirements and the Sponsor’s privacy practices.


15. Integrity of the Giveaway

The Sponsor reserves the right to disqualify entries that are fraudulent, automated, manipulated, duplicated contrary to these Official Rules, or submitted through an attempt to interfere with the proper operation of the Giveaway.

The Sponsor may take reasonable steps to protect the security and integrity of the Giveaway.


16. Technical Problems

The Sponsor is not responsible for technical interruptions outside its reasonable control that prevent an entry from being transmitted or received.

If a material technical issue affects the integrity of the Giveaway, the Sponsor may take reasonable corrective action consistent with applicable law and the fair administration of the Giveaway.


17. Changes or Cancellation

The Sponsor may modify, suspend or cancel the Giveaway where reasonably necessary because of fraud, technical failure, legal requirements, circumstances beyond the Sponsor’s reasonable control, or another event that materially affects the fair administration of the Giveaway.

Any material change will be handled in a manner intended to preserve fairness and comply with applicable requirements.


18. Decisions

Subject to applicable law, decisions of the Sponsor concerning administration and eligibility are final.

Nothing in these Official Rules limits rights that cannot lawfully be excluded.


19. Governing Requirements

The Giveaway is subject to applicable federal and provincial laws and regulations.


20. Contact

Questions regarding the Giveaway may be directed to:

Glara Staging  
Support@glarahome.com

Privacy-related questions may be directed to:

Glara Staging — Support@glarahome.com


SHORT-FORM DISCLOSURE

NO PURCHASE NECESSARY. One (1) prize available with an approximate retail value of CAD $2,000, consisting of a Glara Staging Credit toward an eligible staging service. Open to eligible licensed real estate professionals in British Columbia. Limit one eligible entry per Realtor. Giveaway closes September 29, 2026 at 5:00 PM PT. Odds of winning depend on the number of eligible entries received. Potential winner will be selected by random draw and must satisfy eligibility requirements and correctly answer a skill-testing question before being confirmed. Full Official Rules apply.
